sections.heading: Prohibited under every license
sections.intro: Regardless of the tier you hold, the following uses are always prohibited unless separately negotiated in writing:
sections.aiBody: No BETA ART photograph may be used to train, fine-tune, benchmark, or evaluate any artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative model. The archive exists precisely because human-made photographs remain distinguishable from generated images. Feeding these plates into an AI training pipeline destroys that value proposition and is expressly forbidden, in all license tiers, without exception.

sections.heading: Model releases and third-party content
paragraphs: Photographs of identifiable individuals are only offered under a Commercial or Extended license where a signed model release is on file. This is indicated in the accession record as Release · Model release on file.

Even with a release, licensees must not use portraits in a manner that could reasonably be considered defamatory to the depicted person, or in political or commercial contexts to which the depicted person would reasonably object.

Where a photograph contains identifiable third-party trademarks, artworks, or property, the licensee is responsible for ensuring their intended use is compatible with any rights the third party may hold.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal (angrerett)
paragraphs: For consumer purchases within the EU/EEA, Norwegian law (angrerettloven) grants a 14-day right of withdrawal.

However: because the file is delivered digitally as a distinct copy, and because you expressly consent to immediate delivery and waiver of the withdrawal right at checkout (via the required consent checkbox), the angrerett does not apply once the download link has been sent.
If you did not tick the consent checkbox, you retain the 14-day right but the download will not be released until either (a) you tick the consent or (b) the 14-day period expires.
For B2B purchases (where you are ordering on behalf of a business), the right of withdrawal does not apply.
